The solution is written to `/home/kara/reno/SOLUTION.md` alongside a working, tested implementation. Everything passes.

## Summary

The problem is stateful 32-bit TCP arithmetic implemented in a language whose only number type is a double. A naive bash/awk reconstruction fails silently and intermittently. The root causes and fixes:

| # | Defect | Fix |
|---|--------|-----|
| 1 | `ack > snd_una` breaks across `2^32` | RFC-1982 `seq_after()`: `0 < (a-b+2^32)%2^32 < 2^31` |
| 2 | Unbounded reassembly set | track only `[snd_una, snd_nxt)`, fold SACK blocks into hole count |
| 3 | Wrong FR constants | `ssthresh=max(flight/2,2)`, `cwnd=ssthresh+3`, exit to `cwnd=ssthresh` |
| 4 | Karn ignored | suppress RTT sample when `stime[snd_una] < 0`; RTO `*=2`, clamp `[0.2,60]` |
| 5 | Slow-start off-by-one | `+1` while `cwnd < ssthresh`, else `+1/cwnd` |
| 6 | Piggybacked `A` fed back | only `dir == R` drives ACK state |
| 7 | Unstable/numeric sort | `sort -s -k1,1g` |
| 8 | Float formatting | fixed `%.3f` for cwnd, rounded flight |

## Verified result

```
$ ./run.sh trace1.txt          $ ./run.sh trace2.txt
0.109 20.000 0 64 SS           0.100 11.000 0 64 SS
0.400 10.000 0 10 CA           0.300 12.000 0 64 SS
3.109 6.099 0 5 CA
```

`check.sh` gives byte-for-byte golden diffs, structural invariants, 8 hand-derived oracle checks, and a demonstration that the naive comparison gets *stuck* on the wrapped ACK (`2^32-2000 → 2000`), while `seq_after()` advances correctly:

```
PASS byte-for-byte: trace1
PASS invariants:     trace1
PASS byte-for-byte: trace2
PASS invariants:     trace2
PASS hand-check trace1 r1 cwnd = 20.000
PASS hand-check trace1 r1 ssthresh = 64
PASS hand-check trace1 r1 state = SS
PASS hand-check trace1 r2 ssthresh (flight/2) = 10
PASS hand-check trace1 r2 cwnd (Reno FR exit) = 10.000
PASS hand-check trace1 r3 ssthresh (RTO) = 5
PASS hand-check trace2 wrap r1 cwnd = 11.000
PASS hand-check trace2 wrap r2 cwnd = 12.000
naive a>b for wrapped ack: STUCK (expected STUCK; seq_after() fixes it)
ALL CHECKS PASSED
```

## Artifacts in `/home/kara/reno`

- `run.sh` — `sort -s -k1,1g FILE | awk -f reno.awk`
- `reno.awk` — the full Reno state machine (wrap-safe, SACK holes, Karn/RTO, per-round emit)
- `make_trace.sh` — builds `trace1.txt` (SS → fast retransmit → RTO) and `trace2.txt` (wrap-around)
- `golden1.txt`, `golden2.txt` — locked reference output
- `check.sh` — golden diff + invariants + hand checks
- `SOLUTION.md` — the complete write-up (root-cause analysis, exact code, verification table, reproducibility, portability notes)

Runs on stock `bash 5.3.9` + `mawk 1.3.4` + `sort`, no gawk-only features.
